legacy.rationale: Historical own-constructor rejected-Promise witness. KC1-ARCH-1 decision-01 explicitly retires Promise-return sanitation and forbids manufacturing an unhandled Promise as a passing test. dispatch.test.ts preserves the replacement obligations in Promise independence, inert hostile return misuse, and strict-subprocess Driver-internal rejection tests; it asserts pending after an ignored return and zero observations. No claim that the old unsafe API is safe.

test_path: return misuse: an inert hostile return is never observed; the attempt stays pending
